why_schedule: Constant 0.001 kept pre-clip gradient norms around 15-60, so every step was clipped to norm 1 and the 24-scene success swung from 21/24 to 8/24. The step size is now 10x smaller, with a short warmup and cosine decay to settle the last millimetre.
decision: PASS only if validation RGB free-rollout success exceeds 23/94 and both Oracle and RGB 4-object success are at least 2/16. Checkpoint rank is validation free-rollout placement, not loss. One full training run. No joint fine-tuning.
